subject: POC trial environment options & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeai.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeai.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial environment options & next steps

Thanks again for the call today — great conversation. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we’re aligned on the POC scope and environment options.

Summary of objectives (from our call):
- Validate answer-generation latency under 99th-percentile user flows (~750ms target).
- Confirm integration with AcmeAI’s request router and tokenization pipeline.
- Measure cost-per-1k-requests baseline to compare Hosted vs Dedicated setups.
- Run eval suite against 50 representative prompts (supplied by your team).

Environment options to consider (we discussed pros/cons on the call):
1) Redwood Hosted trial (fastest to start)
   - Pros: no infra setup, quick onboarding (1-2 business days), built-in observability and cost telemetry.
   - Cons: data-in-transit is to our cloud; recommended for non-sensitive test data.
2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPU pool for AcmeAI)
   - Pros: predictable throughput, isolated capacity, supports larger sequences and throughput testing.
   - Cons: longer lead time (1-2 weeks) and minimum reserved hours.
3) VPC/private trial (VPC peering or customer-managed subnet)
   - Pros: data stays in your VPC, suitable for regulated/test-with-production-like networking.
   - Cons: setup overhead (network, KMS), estimated 2-3 weeks.

Proposed success criteria for this POC (suggest we finalize in the follow-up):
- Latency: 99th percentile under 750ms for the 3k token scenario (hosted target vs dedicated measurements).
- Accuracy/regression: regression < 5% on your label set vs your current baseline.
- Cost: Redwood per-token cost within 20% of our estimated baseline for your workload.
- Integration: straightforward API calls and SDK integration; no blockers to engineering sign-off.

Next steps (I recommend):
1) You confirm which environment you prefer for the initial POC (Hosted vs Dedicated vs VPC) by EOD Thu 3/31.
2) Share the 50-sample prompt set and a quick description of expected outputs (Priya, can you share?).
3) If VPC/dedicated chosen, we’ll schedule a technical kickoff with Aditya (SE) and Dylan (infra) to collect network/KMS details.
4) I’ll send an initial POC scope doc and trial checklist (attached) and a calendar invite for a 30-min kickoff once environment choice is confirmed.

Attaching: POC-scope-v1.pdf and Trial-checklist.xlsx for your review.

Best,
Marissa
